Shipping & Delivery

Fast, Reliable Worldwide & USA Delivery.

Transparent shipping times, clear handling standards, free shipping options, and live carrier tracking on all Zavora Fashion orders.

1. Order Processing & Handling Time

All orders are processed, quality-inspected, and dispatched from our fulfillment centers within 1–2 business days (Monday – Friday, excluding public holidays). Orders placed on weekends will begin processing the next business day.

2. USA Shipping Rates & Delivery Estimates

Shipping Option Transit Time Cost
Free Shipping 7–10 Business Days FREE ($0.00)
Standard Shipping 5–8 Business Days $6.99 USD
Express Shipping 2–4 Business Days $14.99 USD

3. Order Tracking

As soon as your package ships, you will receive an automatic dispatch email with your carrier tracking number (USPS, FedEx, or DHL). You can track your shipment live at any time using our Track Order page.

4. Damaged, Lost, or Delayed Shipments

If your package arrives damaged or appears lost in transit, please contact us immediately at support@zavorafashion.com with your order number. We will investigate with the carrier and issue an immediate replacement or full refund.

Shipping Highlights
  • 1–2 day fast handling
  • Free USA delivery available
  • USPS & FedEx tracking
  • No surprise taxes/fees
